title: Shared Outage Triage SOP v2
content:
## Shared Outage Triage SOP v2

Trigger: three or more tickets from distinct reporters all reference the same failing infrastructure zone within a 4-hour window.

Steps:
1. Read all open tickets and identify the infrastructure zone mentioned.
2. If 3+ distinct reporters cite the same zone, classify as shared outage.
3. Tag each shared-outage ticket with: zone-correlated, shared-outage-confirmed
4. Set priority=critical and category=outage-investigation on all shared-outage tickets.
5. Do NOT close any ticket — leave resolution to on-call SRE team.
6. Output one line per ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

Exclusions:
- Maintenance requests, feature requests, and performance tuning tickets are NOT outages.
- A single-reporter ticket citing the same zone does NOT qualify unless there are 3+ distinct reporters for that zone.
- Config review and hardware upgrade tickets are NOT outages.
